desc:
⚽ Welcome to Ultimate Soccer!
The ULTIMATE Soccer experience for all players! Enjoy engaging gameplay, while progressing your soccer/football career to move up the ranks. This game is PERFECT for casual AND competitive players!

🎮CONTROLS:
🖱️LMB: Shoot (Aim with the Camera. By flicking the camera before you release you can curve the shot!)
Hold LMB: POWERSHOT!
🖱️RMB: Pass
⚽Dribble: Q
🦵Bicycle Kick: F
🌈Rainbow Flick: Spacebar
Header: Jump towards a ball that’s in the air 
Tackle: E
Shiftlock: C

💡HELP
 🔘 You can get items, animations, goal effects, and more by buying packs!
 🔘 Your OVR is based on your stats, level + in-game performance!

🔔 Join our community server for updates on the game!

🖥️📱🎮  Supports PC & Mobile & Console (Xbox, PS4/PS5)
